source:
你隶属于某个为达到某个目的而宣誓的骑士团。骑士团的本质目标决定了你宣誓的誓言，在你的眼中看来为达到这目的做出的誓言毫无疑问是光荣而重大并愿意为之努力奋斗的。费伦大陆上有着许许多多的骑士团，所有的骑士团们都有着关于他们行为和责任相似的展望。 
说到“骑士”就会认为是那些穿着重甲，有着贵族血统和骑士精神的高贵战士们，然而在费伦，骑士团们并没有把他们的入会资格限定的如此之高。对目标和理念的追求远远高于成员们装备和战斗风格的限定，因此骑士团中并不会限定战斗方式，并向所有愿意为骑士团理念战斗和献出生命的平民百姓们开放。
“费伦大陆骑士团”边栏更好的介绍了几个在北地活跃的骑士团，可以帮助你决定哪个骑士团让你准备决定为之效忠。
target:
You belong to an order of knights sworn to accomplish a particular purpose. The order's fundamental aims determine your oath, which you regard as unquestionably honorable and important, and worthy of your devoted efforts. Faerûn has many knightly orders, all with similar expectations concerning their members' conduct and responsibilities.
The word knight brings to mind noble warriors in heavy armor, with aristocratic blood and a chivalrous spirit. In Faerûn, however, knightly orders do not set their requirements for membership so narrowly. Commitment to their goals and ideals matters far more than restrictions on equipment or fighting styles. These orders therefore do not prescribe a particular way of fighting and welcome ordinary people willing to fight and give their lives for the order's ideals.
The Knightly Orders of Faerûn sidebar introduces several orders active in the North in greater detail and can help you decide which order deserves your allegiance.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H27. All three paragraphs and the sidebar reference retained; no equipment, ancestry, or combat-style restriction added.

source:
作为一名会为钱财而战的佣兵，你很熟悉如何以失去生命或肢体为风险赌注投入冒险。现在，你开始期待以冒险者的身份投入对敌战斗中，并以此收获更大的回报。你的经历使你得以熟悉佣兵生活的细节，而你甚至还带着一些在沙场上经历过的悲惨往事。你可能曾服务于某个大集团如散塔林会，或曾经作为“明檀 Mintarn”的士兵服役，你或许还曾经参与过其他一些更小规模的卖剑打手团体，而且可能还在多个团体间辗转。（见“北地的佣兵团”边栏中的一系列范例。） 
你现在正寻求某些其他的东西，也许是打算为所冒风险求得更大的回报，或是决定从此自由的活动。无论出于何种原因，你都决心将曾经作为受雇士兵的生涯抛于脑后，但你掌握的技能仍令你无可否认的适合战斗生涯，因此你仍然在战场里过活，只是以另一种不同的形式参与其中。
target:
As a mercenary who fights for pay, you are familiar with venturing into danger at the risk of life and limb. Now you look forward to fighting enemies as an adventurer and earning greater rewards. Your experience has taught you the details of mercenary life, and you still carry some tragic memories from the battlefield. You might have served a large organization such as the Zhentarim or soldiered for Mintarn. You might instead have belonged to smaller bands of sellswords, perhaps moving between several. See the Mercenary Companies of the North sidebar for examples.
You now seek something different, perhaps a greater return for the risks you take or the freedom to act independently. Whatever your reason, you have resolved to leave your career as a hired soldier behind. Yet your skills make you undeniably suited to a fighting life, so you still make your living on the battlefield, taking part in a different way.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H28. Mintarn is provided in the source. All possible employers, motives, and the sidebar reference retained.

source:
你在成为冒险者前，生活中就已充满了冲突和兴奋，因为你是依靠追捕他人来赚钱过活。与某些收集赏金之人不同，你并不是个穿越荒野追捕猎物的荒蛮之人。你会在你居住之地参与一宗利润丰厚的买卖，然后一如既往的考验自己的技能与生存本能。此外，你还跟野外的赏金猎人不一样，你并不孤单：你时常与犯罪分子和其他赏金猎人进行互动，并同时游走于这两个区间并以此获取成功。 
你可能是个灵巧的捕快，时刻在屋顶上徘徊，捕捉城里数之不尽的窃贼。你或许是个非常熟悉街道之人，熟悉窃贼行会和街头帮派的所作所为。你可能是个戴“丝绒面具”的赏金猎人，以此混迹上流社会和贵族圈子，并在其中抓捕那掠夺富人之罪犯，而无论其是小偷小贼还是诈骗高手。你所在的社区可能是费伦的大城市之一（比如深水城或博德之门），或者是人口较少的地方（比如路斯坎 Luskan 或雅塔 Yartar），或是任何可能滋生猎物的地点。
作为冒险队伍一员时，你可能会觉得当个人日程与团队目标相左时会出现某些困难。不过从另一角度看，你也可以利用同伴的帮助拿下更可怕的目标。
target:
Even before you became an adventurer, your life was full of conflict and excitement: you earned your living by hunting people down. Unlike some bounty hunters, you are not a wilderness stalker pursuing quarry through the wilds. You work a lucrative trade where you live, regularly testing your skills and survival instincts. Unlike bounty hunters in the wilderness, you are not alone. You frequently deal with criminals and other bounty hunters, moving between both circles to succeed.
You might be an agile thief-catcher, prowling rooftops in pursuit of the city's countless thieves. You might know the streets intimately, along with the activities of thieves' guilds and street gangs. You might be a bounty hunter wearing a velvet mask, mingling with high society and the nobility to catch criminals who prey on the wealthy, from petty thieves to master swindlers. Your community could be one of Faerûn's great cities, such as Waterdeep or Baldur's Gate, a less populous place such as Luskan or Yartar, or anywhere your quarry might be found.
As a member of an adventuring party, you might find it difficult when your personal schedule conflicts with the group's goals. On the other hand, your companions can help you take down more formidable targets.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H29. Retains all three example hunting styles, all four cities, and the personal-schedule/group-goal tension. Existing Luskan and Yartar spellings retained.

source:
虽然你可能刚刚才来到文明之地，但在追求霸权的过程中，你对合作与集体努力的价值并不陌生。而你正是以乌斯伽部族成员的身份学会这些原则。 
你的同胞总喜欢坚持老方法。乌斯伽人秉持的传统和禁忌让他们得以在其他王国陷入混乱和毁灭后依然保持强大。但最近几代人里，一些部族的帮众开始想要定居，安于和平、贸易，甚至建起了城镇。也许这就是为何乌斯伽会在那些生活在其神力下之人中竖起其图腾。也许这些人需要被提醒一下自己的真实身份，自己源自何处。“乌斯伽的选民 Chosen of Uthfar”会带领帮众重回旧路，而大多数你的同胞都会放弃软弱的文明转向回归。
你可能在一个已决定定居下来的部族中长大，而你的部族已决定放弃旧的行事方式，但你却依然摇摆不定。或者你也可以是遵循传统的乌斯伽人其中一分子，但你只想通过取得伟大功绩来为自己的部族带来荣耀。
参阅第 2 章的“乌斯伽各地”一节，了解每个部族领地及其活动的详细情况，作为你选择自己归属的参考。
target:
Although you might only recently have reached civilized lands, you already understand the value of cooperation and collective effort in the pursuit of dominance. You learned these principles as a member of an Uthgardt tribe.
Your people prefer to hold to the old ways. Uthgardt traditions and taboos have kept them strong even after other kingdoms fell into chaos and ruin. In recent generations, however, followers of some tribes have sought to settle down, embracing peace and trade and even building towns. Perhaps that is why Uthgar raises his totems among those who live under his divine power. Perhaps these people need a reminder of who they truly are and where they come from. The Chosen of Uthfar lead their followers back to the old ways, and most of your people abandon the softness of civilization and return.
You might have grown up in a tribe that chose to settle down and abandon its former ways, while you remain undecided. Alternatively, you might be a traditional Uthgardt who simply wishes to bring glory to your tribe through great deeds.
See the Uthgardt Lands section in chapter 2 for details of each tribe's territory and activities to help you choose your affiliation.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H30. The supplied English title Chosen of Uthfar is retained exactly; Uthfar may be a source misspelling, not silently corrected. Chapter 2, both possible origins, and the source's statements about settling and returning are retained.

source:
你是深水城某伟大贵族家族之后裔。作为小心翼翼地守护自己在“光辉之城 City of Splendors”的特权与地位之人类家族，深水的贵族们在整个费伦因其骄奢和富有而享有盛名。 
不管你是这个名声的光辉榜样还是作为该规则的例外，当人们知道你姓氏及其含义时，便会对你有所期待。你投身冒险的理由某种程度上可能与你的家人相关：你是否作为家族异类，喜欢钻到肮脏地下城的舞会里喝一小口 “兹沙 zzar ” ？或是你是为家人的利益而拿起剑与法术，以确保他们能有个有名望之人作为传承？
你要与 DM 一起决定自己所属之家族在深水中有大约七十五个血统，其中的每个家族都保有其自己独特的偏好经济来源、专职和谋划。你可能是家族中的当主一脉的成员，也可能终有一天成为他们的领袖。或者你也可能属于众多表亲血脉其一，而他们的声望较低其负担的责任也更少。
target:
You are descended from one of Waterdeep's great noble families. These human families carefully guard their privileges and standing in the City of Splendors. Waterdeep's nobles are renowned throughout Faerûn for their extravagance and wealth.
Whether you exemplify that reputation or are an exception to it, people have expectations when they learn your surname and what it means. Your reasons for adventuring might have something to do with your family. Are you the family outsider, who likes slipping into balls in filthy dungeons to sip zzar? Or do you take up sword and spell for your family's interests, ensuring that they have someone of distinction to carry on their legacy?
Work with your DM to decide which family you belong to. Waterdeep has approximately seventy-five noble bloodlines, each with its own distinctive preferences, sources of income, specialties, and schemes. You might belong to the family's ruling branch and become its leader one day. Or you might belong to one of its many cousin branches, with less prestige and fewer responsibilities.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H31. Approximately seventy-five bloodlines retained. The source's awkward combination of dungeon, ball, and zzar is translated as written rather than reconstructed from another text. City of Splendors and zzar are supplied English names.

source: 作为波洛斯教团的一员，你将你的全部生命奉献给对天使的服务以及为拉尼卡带来正义与和平的事业上。你或许会被天使们的行为所鼓舞，经历了艰难困苦，成为波洛斯信念的虔信者，最终为正义事业奉献终生。你也可能是受迫于父母的期盼，被招募官的花言巧语所迷惑，或者是希望干一件惊天动地的大事，因而在波洛斯的军队中一步一步向上爬，最终成为犬儒主义的官僚。
target: As a member of the Boros Legion, you devote your entire life to serving the angels and bringing justice and peace to Ravnica. You might have been inspired by the angels' deeds, endured hardship, become a devout believer in Boros ideals, and ultimately dedicated your life to justice. Alternatively, parental expectations, a recruiter's smooth talk, or the hope of doing something momentous might have led you to climb the ranks of the Boros army, eventually becoming a cynical bureaucrat.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H33. Both contrasting paths, including the cynical bureaucrat outcome, retained without replacing the source narrative.

source:
你是一个间谍。你收集秘密与虚假信息并进行交易。你潜伏在阴影里，渗透进其他公会里，并盗取最宝贵的秘密，无论这些秘密是写在上锁的日记里还是藏在某人的脑海里。甚至你可能毫不关心你所执行的任务背后的任何原因。有时，一个任务的唯一目的就是隐藏在城市的另一个地区进行的另一次袭击背后的动机，又或者只是为了散布恐慌。
作为你在底密尔会堂的隐秘工作的一部分，你可能会伪装成另一个公会的一员。你能够选择你的第二个公会或者投骰来随机决定。你的第二个公会的身份会决定你的一部分初始装备，同时也是你大多数人际交往的来源。
target:
You are a spy. You collect and trade in secrets and false information. You lurk in the shadows, infiltrate other guilds, and steal the most valuable secrets, whether they are written in locked journals or hidden in someone's mind. You might not care at all about the reasons behind your assignments. Sometimes an assignment exists only to conceal the motive for another attack elsewhere in the city, or simply to spread fear.
As part of your covert work for House Dimir, you might pose as a member of another guild. You can choose your secondary guild or roll to determine it randomly. Your identity in that secondary guild determines some of your starting equipment and provides most of your social connections.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H34. Retains both methods of selecting a secondary guild and its equipment/social consequences; no missing random table invented.

source: 你是大部落中的一份子——一个不断蔓延生长的有机体的一部分。就像你是群落的一部分一样，整个群落也是更大的生态系统中，那生与死，腐朽与重生之间永不休的循环中的一部分。你的一生就是整个生态系统中的一小片涟漪，活在城市的黑暗中，与各类腐朽破败为伴。葛加理人天性淡漠，他们无惧死亡，也不忌讳死亡，对他们来说，这只是循环中比较激烈的一环罢了。
target: You are part of the great swarm, a piece of an organism that constantly spreads and grows. Just as you belong to the swarm, the whole swarm belongs to a larger ecosystem and its ceaseless cycle of life and death, decay and rebirth. Your life is a small ripple within that ecosystem, spent in the city's darkness amid all manner of rot and ruin. The Golgari are detached by nature. They neither fear death nor avoid its mention; to them, it is simply a more intense stage of the cycle.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H35. All nested ecosystem/cycle comparisons and attitudes toward death retained.

source: 整个拉尼卡世界都是一个不规则的大都市，但是你是一个在那些仍然存在的旷野区域中的土著，诸如被废弃的街区，瓦砾区，自然生长的公园和摇摇欲坠的废墟。你是那些拼命坚守着古老道途的野蛮社会中的一员。你们奉行着古老的道途——适应自然，充满着原始的愤怒并且为世界充斥着文明的持续进军而忏悔。
target: The whole world of Ravnica is an irregular metropolis, but you are native to the wild places that still remain: abandoned districts, rubblebelts, overgrown parks, and crumbling ruins. You belong to a savage society desperately holding to ancient ways. You follow those old ways, adapting to nature, filled with primal rage, and doing penance for civilization's continuing advance across the world.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H36. All four wild-area examples retained. Doing penance follows the source verb; its unusual implication is not replaced with remembered Gruul wording.

source: 你拥有创造性的智能、对魔法技术的热爱、以及不竭的精力，是伊捷联盟研究工作的积极参与者。虽然你的职业生涯最开始可能只是个侍从，但是你可以立志成为一个熟练的法师或炼金术士，一个实验室的主管，甚至一个手持火焰喷射器负责保卫实验室的焦灼使者。令人着迷的、才华横溢的、雄心勃勃的伊捷是拉尼卡上一股不可预测的混乱力量，而你就是所有这一切品质的缩影。
target: With a creative intellect, a love of magical technology, and inexhaustible energy, you take an active part in the Izzet League's research. Although your career might begin as no more than an attendant, you can aspire to become an accomplished mage or alchemist, a laboratory director, or even a scorchbringer defending a laboratory with a flamethrower. Fascinating, brilliant, and ambitious, the Izzet are an unpredictable force of chaos in Ravnica, and you embody all these qualities.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H37. Retains every possible role, including the flamethrower-bearing laboratory defender; no role mechanics added.

source:
拥有巨额财富的前景，是加入欧佐夫集团成员的希望。这个行会的所有努力都是为了将财富从拉尼卡社会输送到欧佐夫家族，并将战利品集中在最高阶层。作为这个系统的一名工作人员，你最大的希望是尽可能多地索取通过你手中的钱财，这样你就可以通过自己的努力获得更重要的地位。
不管你的过去和你家庭的财富。在你证明自身的价值之前，你在公会的初始状态是接近底部的。
target:
The prospect of immense wealth is what those joining the Orzhov Syndicate hope for. All the guild's efforts channel wealth from Ravnican society into Orzhov families, concentrating the spoils at the very top. As a worker within this system, your greatest hope is to claim as much as possible of the money passing through your hands, earning a more important position through your own efforts.
Whatever your past or your family's wealth, you begin near the bottom of the guild until you prove your worth.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H38. Retains the concentration of wealth, personal advancement motive, and near-bottom starting status regardless of family wealth.

source:
你本质上是一个艺人，一个有戏剧天赋和对聚光灯的热爱的表演者。你已经花了多年时间磨练你的技艺，掌握了一套要求很高的技能，这样你就可以华丽地表演它们，让它们看起来很容易。疯狂的掌声，人群的尖叫，混乱和恐怖蔓延到大街上——这就是你活着的目的。
你也是一个崇拜一个喜欢暴力和混乱的古老恶魔的信徒。正因如此你的最高愿望就是用自己的表演取悦亵渎者、暴动之王。
target:
At heart, you are an entertainer, a performer with a flair for drama and a love of the spotlight. You have spent years honing your craft and mastering demanding skills so that you can perform them with flair and make them look easy. Frenzied applause, the crowd's screams, chaos and terror spilling into the streets: these are what you live for.
You are also a devotee of an ancient demon who delights in violence and chaos. Your highest aspiration is therefore to please the Defiler, the Lord of Riots, with your performances.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H39. Retains both entertainer and cultist aspects and both titles stated by the source.

source: 你是一个建立在和谐理想的基础上的，受祝福的社区的一员。在这里，自然与文明和谐共存，按照世界之魂太瑟雷尼亚的意志生存成长。作为瑟雷尼亚盟会的一员，你的周围是和你有着同样世界观，并渴望与世界建立更深层次的精神交流的其他人和生物，而你也热切渴望与拉尼卡分享你的快乐经历。此外，你也同样致力于和盟会的其他成员一起对抗其他公会的野心——必要时会使用武力。
target: You belong to a blessed community founded on the ideal of harmony. Here, nature and civilization coexist peacefully, living and growing according to the will of Mat'Selesnya, the Worldsoul. As a member of the Selesnya Conclave, you are surrounded by people and creatures who share your worldview and desire a deeper spiritual communion with the world. You eagerly wish to share your joyful experiences with Ravnica. You are also committed to joining other members of the Conclave in opposing the ambitions of other guilds, using force if necessary.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08
note: 2024 H40. Harmony, spiritual communion, sharing joy, and willingness to use force are all retained.

source: 一枚析米克徽章，一套平民服饰，一本研究笔记，一支钢笔，一瓶乌贼墨汁，一瓶油(由鲸脂制成)，一瓶酸(从消化液中提取)，一瓶鱼鳞，一瓶海藻，一瓶水母刺，一瓶不明黏液，一个装有10gp(或俄佐立发行的1基诺zino硬币)的袋子。
target: A Simic insignia, a set of common clothes, a research notebook, a pen, a bottle of squid ink, a flask of oil made from whale blubber, a vial of acid extracted from digestive fluids, a vial of fish scales, a vial of seaweed, a vial of jellyfish stingers, a vial of unidentified slime, and a pouch containing 10 gp or one Azorius-issued zino coin.

source: 想象一个完美的世界:自然与文明和谐共存，相互适应;生命与环境被塑造得和谐相称。这就是你一直试图在析米克联合的实验室中塑造的世界。自然是关于适应、进化和平衡的——但是为了跟上文明的发展脚步，自然需要生机师和地貌塑师的帮助。如果在这个过程中，你碰巧创造了超级士兵和变异怪物，使得它们可以增强析米克联合对其他公会的计划和野心的防御，那就更好不过了。
target: Imagine a perfect world: nature and civilization coexist harmoniously and adapt to each other, while life and its environment are shaped to fit together. This is the world you have always tried to create in the laboratories of the Simic Combine. Nature is about adaptation, evolution, and balance, but it needs the help of biomancers and terraformers to keep pace with civilization. If, in the process, you happen to create super-soldiers and mutant monsters that strengthen the Simic Combine's defenses against other guilds' schemes and ambitions, so much the better.
reviewed_by: Codex content agent full source review; root sampled quantities and conditions; background key formulas independently checked, 2026-09-08

不管怎么说，你抛下了往日生活日复一日的痛苦，代之以兴奋与奇遇的人生。是你的旧债已被偿还，是你认为无法避免的责任已成为过去，或是你突然拥有了常人所未知晓的罕见与独特的技能。

Perhaps you stumbled upon a Deck of Many Things and drew a powerful card with a beneficial effect. Or perhaps you inherited a small fortune from a distant relative you never knew existed.
Whatever happened, you left behind the daily misery of your former life for one of excitement and extraordinary experiences. Perhaps your old debts were paid, obligations you thought unavoidable became a thing of the past, or you suddenly gained rare and unusual abilities unknown to ordinary people.

target:
Everything had been going so well! You enjoyed a life of luxury, love, and comfort until you suddenly lost it all. Perhaps a rampaging dragon or another monster destroyed everything you owned in one disastrous afternoon. Or perhaps you sought a Deck of Many Things to make your successful life even more glorious, only to draw a devastating card that changed your fate forever.
Desperation drove you into an adventuring career. You do not explore dark dungeons and their monstrous inhabitants for pleasure or glory; you do it because you have no other path. But you have risen on fortune's wheel before. With opportunity and perseverance, why should you not rise again?

As a Grinner, your goal is to spread freedom and inspire hope among oppressed people, or to bring about a revolution in the future.
